newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Nov manufacturing input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Nov manufacturing input prices fall.

text.p: Australia's manufacturing input prices fell 0.4 percent in November from the previous month and were 3.5 percent lower on the year, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
Price falls for cattle and sheep were the main contributors to the fall in the index, the bureau said in a statement.
"The overall fall was partly offset by price increases for copper concentrates and imported crude oil," it said.
The November fall follows a rise of 0.7 percent in October, which was the first increase since January last year.
It was the ninth consecutive drop in the index year-on-year.
